t: This is the former Alexandra Theatre in Stoke Newington, which later became a cinema. It was designed by Frank Matcham, an English architect who specialised in theatres and music halls. In forty years he designed over ninety theatres and refurbished around eighty more throughout the United Kingdom. His London credits include Hackney Empire, Shepherd's Bush Empire, the Coliseum and the Palladium, and his last major commission before retirement was the Victoria Palace Theatre. The Alexandra is a neighbourhood piece of that large legacy.
